items.title: Creating green spaces that bring beauty and substance into your life.
our Mission
items.body:
Our mission is simple, we want to create green spaces that can feed our body and mind while creating community. We hope that our garden spaces encourage our neighbors to come together and share in the dialogue of food and in the harvest of course!

By being mindful of the environment and native habitats, we can create gardens that enrich our lives while promoting local fauna. We push back against water hungry lawns and strive to create spaces that bring beauty and substance to your home through organic and sustainable practices.

We specialize in native, drought tolerant, and edible gardens in Los Angeles, and offer installation and maintenance services. To get a personalized quote, contact us.

items.title: Edible Garden
items.body: This completely edible garden offers both sustenance and aesthetic delight in every corner. Vibrant herbs and edible flowers carpet the ground, while artichokes and lemongrass add intriguing textures. Nutrient-rich organic vegetables thrive in raised beds, and a sprawling 50-foot passion fruit vine now adorns a wall once covered in ivy.
items.subtitle: Ann's Garden

items.title: edible Garden
items.body: In this captivating formal garden, design seamlessly blends with function, directing attention to the raised beds and vibrant vegetation as the central features. This is where beauty not only delights the eye but serves a purpose.
items.subtitle: John's Garden

items.title: Edible garden
items.body: Kate's beautiful garden thrives on high density planting and efficiency. This summer garden grows a variety of leafy greens, squash, tomatoes, herbs and even edible flowers!
items.subtitle: Kate's Garden

items.title: Edible Garden
items.body: This garden exudes the atmosphere of an urban orchard imbued with a tranquil homestead charm. Dotted with vibrant pollinators, this enchanting space yields a bounty of citrus fruits, figs, pomegranates, berries, and even chestnuts. And let's not overlook the raised beds brimming with lush greens and traditional herbs.
items.subtitle: Sanam's Garden

items.title: Balcony Hydroponic Garden
items.body: Nicole's smile says it all. Hydroponic towers maximize urban space, enabling year-round production of fresh, nutritious food with minimal water usage. Accessible and efficient, they empower individuals to cultivate their own sustainable food sources, promoting self-sufficiency and resilience. Nicole loves coming out to her balcony to harvest greens, tomatoes, herbs, squash and the occasional broccoli head.
items.subtitle: Nicole's Garden

items.title: Green Girl Farms
items.body: We are a proud partner of this urban oasis where innovation meets sustainability. As pioneers in the movement, Green Girl Farms is dedicated to nurturing not just crops, but communities, empowering those around the Port of Los Angeles to embrace a greener, more inclusive future.
items.subtitle: Green Girl

items.title: Feed and Be Fed
items.body: Feed and be Fed is a non-profit urban garden dedicated to restoring food justice in the community of San Pedro by growing and distributing organic whole foods. We are proud to be able to take part in supporting their mission.
items.subtitle: Feed and Be Fed

items.title: Alma
items.body: ALMA exists to re-claim lives of formerly incarcerated people, re-purpose land into productive urban farms, and re-imagine community as a place for people & plants to thrive. We are happy to have been part of their mission and grow out their farm from 2019-2021.

Aphids in your kale? Scale in your fruit trees? Grubs in your soil? The list goes on and on.

We use safe OMRI certified products to take care of any pest infestation you may have.

What is IPM?
Integrated Pest Management is an effective and environmentally sensitive approach to pest management. It uses information on the life cycles of pests and their interaction with the environment to determine the bests steps to take with the least possible hazard to people, property, and the environment
